name: mcp_tool_resolve_client_cert
notes: mTLS client-cert resolution ladder. PORT FIX: src/tools/mcp_tool.c::mcp_tool_resolve_client_cert was a signature-mismatched simplification (cert+key concat, no branches, no ~ expansion, no isfile); rewritten to the full LIVE tools/mcp_tool.py::_resolve_client_cert ladder (none / list form len2-len3 with key mutual-exclusion and string passphrase check / string form single-vs-pair; _expand validates non-blank strings, expands ~ via $HOME, and requires a regular file). Returns a JSON result object encoding kind or error class. Fixture paths use /etc/hostname (regular file) and /etc (directory, fails os.path.isfile) so both sides see identical filesystem truth. Harness carries a traced copy of the ported ladder; the real ports file is linked via extra_src.
